consent.title: Before you start
consent.body:
Shikshakalay is a practice tool made by three students for a hackathon. It is not a government programme.
You will teach short lessons to pretend children made by AI, and get private tips.
• Your voice is turned into text, then the recording is deleted.
• We keep the text of your lessons to improve the tool. We never share your name or number.
• Trainers only see totals from 5 or more teachers.
• You can stop at any time. Ask us and we will delete your data.

wa.consent:
Namaste! Shikshakalay is a practice tool made by three students for a hackathon. It is not a government programme.
You will teach short lessons to pretend children made by AI, and get private tips.
• Your voice is turned into text, then the recording is deleted.
• We keep the text of your lessons to improve the tool. We never share your name or number.
• Trainers only see totals from 5 or more teachers.
• Send STOP at any time to stop. Ask us and we will delete your data.
Reply YES to agree.
wa.lang: Which language? Reply 1 for English, 2 for हिन्दी.
wa.menu: What would you like to practise? Reply 1 for 2-digit subtraction with bundles and sticks.
wa.howTo: Send a voice note (under 30 seconds) or type what you would say to the class. Send END to finish.
wa.checkin: Did you try yesterday's line in class? Reply 1 for Yes, 2 for Not yet.
wa.checkinThanks: Thank you! Send 1 to practise again any time.
wa.stop: You won't get any more messages. Send YES any time to start again.
wa.rejoinTip: Tip: this test number forgets you after 3 days. To keep practising, send "{joinCode}" to +1 415 523 8886.
wa.tooLong: That voice note was longer than 30 seconds. Please send a shorter one.
wa.busy: One moment — the children are still answering your last message.
